title: Raaz
desc: A large mansion situated in Nairobi, resounds with the shrieks of its owner Kumar - a young man of Indian origin. Night after night he is woken up by three dreams - a woeful melody of a damsel in distress.

title: Preetam
desc: Raised by his aunt and uncle, orphaned Preetam grows up to become a man who cares for others; Preetam and Anil grow up like brothers, but dark undercurrents of a messy past threaten to destroy the solace and peace Preetam has in his present.

title: Insaf Ka Tarazu
desc: Ramesh, a multi-millionaire, falls madly in love with Bharti. In the turnout of events, Bharti kills Ramesh. Watch the heart wrenching drama to know what compels her to take this dire step.

title: Guddu
desc: Guddu and Salina meet with an accident and she loses her eyesight. Later, when Guddu learns that he is terminally ill, he decides to donate his eyes to her, but his father disapproves.
